name: agentic-research-workflow
description: Cross-surface routing for evidence-first academic and scientific research workflows backed by a versioned GitHub source of truth.

interface.shortDescription: Route evidence-first research across ChatGPT and Codex.
interface.longDescription: Retrieves the current GitHub workflow source, routes substantive academic and scientific tasks, selects specialist Skills, and applies concise evidence and approval quality gates.
defaultPrompt: Evaluate this research goal and route it through the current evidence workflow.
Check whether this citation supports the claim.
Plan a reproducible paper reproduction workflow.
